about: AI Reading the Script is a blurry SpongeBob SquarePants frame in which SpongeBob, standing in front of his pineapple house, holds the end of an enormously long paper scroll that unrolls taller than he is. His face has been edited to look strangely realistic and expressionless, with heavy-lidded human eyes and a mild, vacant smile. The result looks like someone reading lines with zero understanding. It mocks AI voiceovers, chatbots and auto-generated videos that recite text perfectly while having no idea what any of it means, and by extension anyone who reads a script with the same blank delivery.
origin: The edited still circulated on Instagram, TikTok and GIF sites with the caption "AI reading the script", as AI-generated narration and slideshow videos flooded social feeds.
usage:
There is a single box in the white strip above the image. Write who or what is reading, and optionally what they are reading: "AI reading the script", "me reading my presentation", "customer support reading the policy".

It works for anything that recites without understanding: AI narrators mispronouncing names, students reading slides word for word, support agents repeating the FAQ, an NPC with three lines. Keep it short so the blank stare stays the focus.
ideas: me presenting slides I didn't make
customer support reading the refund policy
the NPC telling me about the dragon again
me reading the terms and conditions out loud
